payload.summary: The archived Needle shard is now closed at six direct files. Registry snapshot verifies 62 total / 51 active / 11 locked tools with shallow argument arity. Historical source-inspection says dynamic tool lists are runtime input and likely avoid registry-retrain; direct German behavior, 1024-token headroom and constrained-name closure remain unproven gates. Benchmark lineage conflicts (79.9% older vs 67.9% later Stage-A) must stay versioned. Current contract reconciliation is decisive: Needle may propose/classify but cannot mint effect authority; output crosses immediately into provenance-bound Clay semantics.
